does: The app moves an NPC by the player's walking rules: a move may not end on another creature's square and a hostile one can be passed only with a two-size gap (rules/grid/move.go:214-225, play/combat_move.go:209-213), so the elemental cannot enter a hostile creature's space and stop there; the reflected and entering fire damage are not applied either. The master can place it with a forced move (free, no movement spent)
seen: The trait text only, in the stat block 'Caracteristicas' group of the master's creature sheet / NPC card; no reminder
code: backend/internal/rules/creatures.go monsterDerived (SpecialAbilities become a text-only Feature) and creatureAbilities; web/src/app/shared/creatures/stat-block-view.ts groupsOf
fix: Let the movement rules skip the occupancy refusal for a mover with the trait Fire Form

name: Flyby
says: Doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach
does: The app offers an opportunity attack to every enemy whose reach the mover leaves (play/combat_opportunity.go:102 offerOpportunities) and never reads the trait, so an owl or flying snake that flies out of reach is offered attacks it does not provoke. The master declines or skips the offers by hand
seen: The trait text only, in the stat block 'Caracteristicas' group of the master's creature sheet / NPC card; no reminder
code: backend/internal/play/combat_move.go:888 offerAttacks; backend/internal/play/combat_opportunity.go:109
fix: Skip the offers when the mover has a #flyby trait and is flying

name: Freedom Of Movement
says: Ignores difficult terrain; magic cannot reduce its speed or restrain it; spends 5 ft to escape nonmagical restraints or grapples
does: An NPC drag on its turn pays difficult terrain because only a character's flag lifts it (play/combat_move.go:159), and the Web and Entangle zones restrain it (play/zones_trigger.go:331 restrainInZone, no trait read), though the trait says it ignores difficult terrain and cannot be restrained by magic. The master can use a forced move and remove the restrained effect by hand
